name: squat (arms overhead)
description: A bodyweight squat with arms reaching overhead. It trains the legs and challenges shoulder mobility and trunk stability.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and reach both arms overhead.
Keep your arms in line with your ears and your ribs down.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your heels down and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.
